page.overview:
Who is Elendur of Arnor?

Elendur of Arnor was a Dúnedain of the North and the ninth High King of Arnor.

Elendur was the son of Valandur, who succeeded his father as High King of Arnor for one hundred and twenty-five years. He was perhaps named for Isildur's eldest son, who also bore the name Elendur. He died in TA 777 and his son Eärendur, who would be the last of Arnor's High Kings, succeeded him.

Events from his reign are not precisely known, but it was probably a peaceful one.

The name Elendur is Quenya, meaning "Elf-servant" or "Star-servant".
